purpose: Shared mission shape for visual work, backend queueing, prop reports, and memory summaries.

schema.missionId: same value as id; canonical workflow envelope id
schema.title: short mission title
schema.ownerAgentId: same value as owner; canonical workflow owner
schema.targetId: prop id, room id, or agent id
schema.targetPropId: canonical prop id for dashboard actions and report routing, or null for non-prop missions
schema.actionId: canonical dashboard action id or null

sourcePropIds: source prop ids carried by an Agent Mission/Report transfer
sourceMissionIds: source mission ids carried by an Agent Mission/Report transfer
sourceReportIds: source report ids carried by an Agent Mission/Report transfer

agentTransfer.transferAgentId: backend-selected canonical agent id that owns the destination action
agentTransfer.sourceOwnerAgentId: backend-derived owner of the source report
agentTransfer.handoffMissionId: completed Agent handoff mission id that records delivery

schema.idempotencyKey: caller supplied opaque key or null
schema.autoEligible: boolean; discussion_only and approved_workspace must be false
schema.discussionOnly: true only for a Backend-created interactive-meeting discussion Mission; never accepted as frontend authority
schema.discussionGuardrails: Backend-owned tool/workspace/task/implementation denial record for discussion_only Missions

meetingApprovalBinding.proposalDigest: lowercase SHA-256 digest of the current frozen Manager proposal

meetingImplementationProposal.meetingId: same exact approved meeting session id as meetingApprovalBinding.meetingId
meetingImplementationProposal.proposalDigest: same visible lowercase SHA-256 digest as meetingApprovalBinding.proposalDigest
meetingImplementationProposal.proposalTurnId: same exact Manager proposal turn id as meetingApprovalBinding.proposalTurnId
meetingImplementationProposal.agenda: complete bounded operator agenda without silent truncation
meetingImplementationProposal.developmentGoal: complete bounded operator development goal without silent truncation
meetingImplementationProposal.managerDecision: exact frozen structured Manager decision object
meetingImplementationProposal.approvalNote: complete bounded local-user approval note or empty string

evidence.label: public source title
evidence.note: why this source supports the result

schema.webSearchUsed: true only when the runner recorded a native Codex Web Search tool event
schema.webSearchEvidenceVerified: true only when Web Search was used and safe public evidence URLs were returned
schema.archivedSuccessful: true only when archivedFromStatus was completed

status_rules.queued: Mission exists but no worker is actively running it.
status_rules.waiting_approval: Mission needs human or Risk Guard approval before real execution.
status_rules.running: Backend worker or simulated office action is active.
status_rules.blocked: Worker cannot proceed and must report why.
status_rules.completed: Worker wrote result and optional memory/report card.
status_rules.failed: Backend runner returned an error or invalid output.

execution_rules.agentCollaboration: A scheduled collaboration Mission consumes Codex quota but runs with tools and task creation disabled; Manager must provide the final summary.
execution_rules.frontendReadModel: GET /api/missions derives readyToExecute on the backend and never exposes payloadDigest.
execution_rules.twoStepGate: Approval never runs a tool automatically. A second POST /api/missions/:id/execute is required.
execution_rules.exactConfirmation: The execute body must contain confirmMissionId equal to the URL mission id.
execution_rules.completePacketDigest: Approval binds owner, toolId, targetId, detail, modelTier, budget, risk, and reportType; mutation invalidates approval.
execution_rules.backendRiskGuard: High-risk review is backend-owned and digest-bound; the frontend may submit only the human decision.
execution_rules.singleUse: The approval becomes consumed before the guarded runner starts.
execution_rules.meetingProposalGate: A meeting approval creates one separate high-risk codex_cli_task Mission in approved_workspace mode, bound to meetingId, proposalDigest, and proposalTurnId. It does not execute inline.
execution_rules.meetingDiscussionMode: A Backend-only constructor may create a low-risk agent_collaboration Mission in discussion_only mode for transcript audit and round accounting. Risky words in the agenda do not grant execution authority; tools, Workspace, task creation, and implementation remain disabled.
execution_rules.meetingFullInstructionPreservation: The Runner accepts at most 12,000 collaboration message characters inside a separate 16,000-character trusted envelope; generic Agent Chat remains 4,000 characters. Oversize input fails before model invocation and is never silently truncated.
execution_rules.missionPromptPreservation: Ordinary Mission prompts accept at most 8,000 characters and approved_workspace prompts accept at most 12,000 characters. Oversize prompts fail before process start and are never silently truncated.
execution_rules.visibleMeetingProposalBinding: Before approval, the user-visible proposal exposes its meetingId, proposalDigest, and proposalTurnId. The approved implementation Mission carries those exact values in both meetingApprovalBinding and meetingImplementationProposal; the private Mission payloadDigest remains hidden.
execution_rules.structuredMeetingImplementation: An approved_workspace Mission must carry meetingImplementationProposal with the complete bounded agenda, developmentGoal, frozen proposal, risks, acceptanceChecks, managerDecision, and approvalNote. These structured fields and meetingApprovalBinding are included in the Mission payload digest; prompt text alone is not sufficient authority.
execution_rules.sessionScopedDrafts: Meeting interjection and approval-note drafts are keyed by meeting session id (with a separate new-session key), restored only for that session, and never reused across sessions.
execution_rules.approvedWorkspaceTrigger: Only a fresh explicit POST /api/missions/:id/execute may start the exact bound Mission after Backend revalidates the current proposal, human and Risk Guard decisions, and payload digest.
execution_rules.approvedWorkspaceBoundary: The separate approved implementation profile may write workspace, frontend, backend, runner, contracts, tests, docs, and assets-source only for the exact frozen proposal. Runtime data, scripts, installer, Git, secrets/auth, network or Web Search, Browser/Computer/MCP/Plugin/external apps, deployment, external messaging, MT4/MT5 or live trading, deletion, moving/renaming existing files, and scope expansion remain forbidden. Generic auto_guarded keeps its narrower workspace/frontend/docs/assets-source profile.
execution_rules.restartRecovery: A consumed running mission found during Bridge startup becomes failed/interrupted without automatic retry.
execution_rules.archiveOutcome: Archive preserves archivedFromStatus; only a mission archived from completed counts as successful Manager aggregation.
execution_rules.workflowEnvelope: Every dashboard action must persist missionId, targetPropId, ownerAgentId, sourceLineage, agentTransfer when a report crosses dashboards, timestamps, status, and reportRoute before the result is exposed to a prop or Mission Strategy Table.
execution_rules.independentDashboards: Workflow dashboards are independent workspaces, not ordered pipeline stages. Mission Strategy Table is a global ledger only.
execution_rules.crossDashboardTransfer: A cross-dashboard report may be consumed only through a backend-owned agent_mission_report record. Frontend may submit sourceReportId only; Backend derives sourcePropId, sourceMissionId, transferAgentId, targetPropId, and validates the completed source Mission/Report binding.

storage.archive: Archived records stay in ./data/runtime/missions.json with status=archived; they are not deleted or truncated.
storage.future_durable_archive: SQLite WAL or ./data/runtime/archive/missions/ after a reviewed migration
